evidence: Modifies test/functional/p2p_tx_download.py, which tests peer transaction relay and download behavior.
rationale: Fixing an intermittent failure in p2p_tx_download.py prevents spurious CI failures in p2p relay testing. The description notes that without mocking time on nodes[1], a 2-second wall-clock delay causes nodes[1] to request the transaction from an unresponsive test peer and fail in sync_mempools().
